remarks: Direct Niagara River frontage and nearly 70 years of same-family ownership define this well-maintained 2,302 sq. ft. waterfront home. Offering 3 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and a 3-car garage, the property pairs comfortable indoor living with a true riverfront setting. The updated kitchen features custom-style wood cabinetry, granite counters, a center island, and stainless appliances. Renovated baths include a primary bath refresh completed in 2021 and updated hall baths. Enjoy river views from the covered deck and three-season room, then step down to the expansive lawn and waterfront. The 60-foot dock showcases 3/8-inch steel pilings, plastic lumber decking, a metal roof, and two electric hoists rated at 15,000 lbs. and 10,000 lbs. Great location on the river for water depth. A walkout basement opens directly to the backyard and offers substantial unfinished space, steel walkout doors, and plumbing in place for a possible future bath. Notable updates include A/C and hot water tank in 2023, LeafFilter gutters in 2019, newer bedroom/office flooring, updated siding, deck, and more. A rare opportunity to enjoy the Niagara River from your own backyard. Showings begin Sunday, September 27th.
